evidence.title: Your Users Experience Your Backend Too. - DEV Community

name: Your Users Experience Your Backend Too
summary: dev.to post arguing that backend choices — response times, error messages, API design, architecture — are part of user experience.
description: An opinion piece by Hilda Enyioko on why user experience is not just the interface: slow API response times, unhelpful error messages, API design and system and scaling architecture choices all shape how users experience a product, with a section on why this matters more in the vibecoding era of AI-assisted development.
contains: dev.to article posted 25 Aug by Hilda Enyioko
five sections: API response times, error messages, API design, system architecture, scaling architecture
argues users experience the whole system, not just the frontend
written for the vibecoding era of AI-assisted development
